description_text:
Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Technology Implementation Support.

***Amendment 0001 is hereby issued to revise Provision L-204-LANT004-S(e) to indicate that Subcontractors shall submit their unsanitized proposal via e-mail to the Contract Specialist in accordance with the requirements set forth in paragraph (f) of the Provision. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. This update also includes the Questions and Answers for the questions that were submitted by the deadline included in the RFP.***
